title: 含 VCCS 的正弦稳态戴维宁等效
statement: ω = 1000 rad/s，Us = 10∠0° V（有效值），R1 = 2 Ω，C = 1000 µF，L = 2 mH。电压控制电流源向结点 a 注入电流 0.5U_c（单位 A），U_c 是电容电压（“+”在上）。负载 Z_L = 4 − j1 Ω 接在 a、b 端。
求 a、b 以左电路的戴维宁等效电路（U_oc 和 Z_eq），再求负载电流 I_L。

questions.explain: 开路时 L 中电流 = −0.5U_c（全部来自受控源），结点方程解得 U_c = −j5 V，U_oc = (1 + j)U_c = 5 − j5 V，模 7.07 V。
外加电源法：Us 置零、受控源保留，在 a 注入 1 A，解得 U_c = −j V，U_a = 1 + j V，所以 Z_eq = 1 + j1 Ω。
Z_eq = 1 + j1 Ω（感性）。可用 U_oc/I_sc 验证：短路时 I_sc = 5 − j5 … 见完整解答。

hints: 复导纳：1/R1 = 0.5 S，Y_C = jωC = j1 S，Y_L = 1/(jωL) = −j0.5 S。以 c、a 为独立结点，受控源先当独立源。
开路电压：结点 a 只有 L 和受控源两个电流，KCL 给出 U_a 与 U_c 的关系。
含受控源不能直接串并联求 Z_eq：Us 置零、受控源保留，从 a 注入 1 A，求 U_a（数值上就是 Z_eq）。

en.title: Thevenin equivalent with a VCCS in sinusoidal steady state
statement: ω = 1000 rad/s, Us = 10∠0° V (rms), R1 = 2 Ω, C = 1000 µF, L = 2 mH. The voltage-controlled current source injects 0.5U_c (in A) into node a, where U_c is the capacitor voltage ("+" at the top). The load Z_L = 4 − j1 Ω is connected at a, b.
Find the Thevenin equivalent (U_oc and Z_eq) of the circuit to the left of a, b, then the load current I_L.

questions.explain: With the port open, the current in L is −0.5U_c (it all comes from the dependent source); the node equations give U_c = −j5 V and U_oc = (1 + j)U_c = 5 − j5 V, magnitude 7.07 V.
Test source: zero Us, keep the dependent source, inject 1 A into a. The solution is U_c = −j V, U_a = 1 + j V, so Z_eq = 1 + j1 Ω.
Z_eq = 1 + j1 Ω (inductive). It can be checked with U_oc/I_sc — see the full solution.

hints: Admittances: 1/R1 = 0.5 S, Y_C = jωC = j1 S, Y_L = 1/(jωL) = −j0.5 S. Use c and a as the independent nodes and treat the dependent source as independent at first.
Open-circuit voltage: node a has only two currents, the one in L and the dependent source; KCL there relates U_a and U_c.
With a dependent source you cannot use series/parallel rules for Z_eq: zero Us, keep the dependent source, inject 1 A into a and find U_a (numerically equal to Z_eq).
solution: **1. Admittances.** G1 = 0.5 S, Y_C = jωC = j1 S, Y_L = −j0.5 S.

**3. Equivalent impedance (test source).** Zero Us and inject 1 A into a: node c: (0.5 + j0.5)U_c + j0.5U_a = 0; node a: (−0.5 + j0.5)U_c − j0.5U_a = 1. Adding them: jU_c = 1 → U_c = −j, and then U_a = 1 + j V, so **Z_eq = 1 + j1 Ω**.

**4. Check (short-circuit current).** With a, b shorted U_a = 0: node c: (0.5 + j0.5)U_c = 5 → U_c = 5 − j5 V; the short-circuit current = current in L + dependent-source current = −j0.5U_c + 0.5U_c = (0.5 − j0.5)(5 − j5) = −j5 A. U_oc/I_sc = (5 − j5)/(−j5) = 1 + j Ω ✓.
